entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original square 1024x1024 transparent PNG reaction sticker for Raymond, the exact blue elephant professor in the two reference images. Image 1 and image 2 are identity/style references, not layouts to reproduce. Preserve his warm large brown eyes, round bronze glasses, blue tuft, rounded ears, naturally gently curled trunk, blue palette and warm painterly cartoon illustration. Primary request: Raymond gives a friendly welcoming wave, smiling with one raised small blue elephant hand beside his face. Head and a little bust only, readable at emoji size, expressive and distinct from a neutral smile. Anatomically natural hands and trunk. Center the whole silhouette with 10% transparent breathing room on every side. Genuinely transparent background, no scene, no shadow plate, no text, no letters, no logo, no border, no watermark. Keep the soft painted texture and generous facial proportions. Do not redesign him realistically or make the trunk strange.
